Job Summary

Job Title- Group Data Privacy (GDP) - Data Privacy Analyst, AS

Location- Bangalore, India

Role Description

  • CAFC is responsible for managing the compliance and anti-financial crime risk of Deutsche Bank Group. Our mission is to ensure that CAFC services are provided to the bank with the goals of protecting its integrity and reputation and managing legal risk to make transactions viable and safe. We partner with Risk, Regulation, Legal, Group Audit and others to provide a proactive integrated risk management approach.
  • We work closely with managers to coordinate activities across business lines so we avoid violations of laws. We make sure the Bank has up-to-date information on regulatory and legal changes and continues to be seen as a trusted, respected market participant.

Group Data Privacy (GDP)

  • Group Data Privacy (GDP) is an independent 2nd Line of Defense risk type control function within Legal which defines the risk management framework for data protection and privacy risks. GDP is located in Frankfurt, New York, London, and Berlin and Bangalore organized in a matrix structure with regional Data Protection Officers (DPOs) and Business Partners providing guidance to Business Divisions and Infrastructure Functions.
  • Moreover, GDP manages a global network of local, internal data protection officers and rolled-out a controls framework in order to safeguard Deutsche Bank s integrity and reputation and to ensure the correct processing of personal data entrusted to us. As part of the TPRM process, as a 2LoD control function, GDP is mandated to review third party outsourcing activities adherence with data privacy requirements.

Your key responsibilities

  • Advise and perform on the Data Protection Impact Assessment, in close collaboration with the stakeholders in the 1st Line and the respective GDP Business Partner and DPO. Ensure a professional documentation of the DPIA relevant facts, the (potential) privacy risk and mitigation measures.
  • Adivse and support in the banks global AI related governance process (AI Oversight Forum), in close collaboration with the stakeholders in the 1st Line, the other Risk Function in the AIOF as well the respective GDP Business Partner and DPO. Ensure a professional documentation of the AI use case, support the identification of (potential) privacy risk and mitigation measures in a timely manner .
  • Advise and perform the initial review of Data Breach notifications ensuring that the respective GDP Business Partner and DPO are timely involved and support them with their Data Breach assessment and documentation in order to avoid and mitigate potential data privacy risks
  • Advise and support the Service Officers of divisions and infrastructure functions on Data Protection related controls, attestations and evidences and GDP Assessment in order to meet the data protection requirements including Schrems II requirements.
  • Remain informed of regulatory developments in the data protection related outsourcing requirements including relevant GDP Policies and procedures as well as (assist if required in) maintenance of GDP Key Operating Documents
  • Prepare submission to GDP Business Partners respectively local DPO for risk acceptance / approval in line with GDP Key Operating Documents (KOD), follow up and escalation, if required.
  • Maintain GDP related documentation of transactions, respective findings and documented risks in the GDP tool.
  • Collaborate closely with GDP Business Partner and local DPOs as well as other control functions units performing privacy assessment tasks.
  • Develop and maintain knowledge of the data privacy regulatory requirements applicable to DB incl. the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and remain up-to-date with relevant regulatory requirements and industry trends.
  • Maintain close collaboration with other functions within GDP such as Law Monitoring and Training Awareness.
  • Provide ad hoc support for Controls Assurance activities when required.

Your skills and experience

  • University degree, preferably in Business or Operations, law degree a plus
  • Knowledge of privacy regulations, financial industry, outsourcing or IT background a plus
  • Experience with managing deadlines and working to tight deadlines
  • Experience in making formal (written or oral) presentations and recommendations in a corporate setting
  • English proficiency (oral and written) a must. German a plus
  • Computer proficiency in Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Lotus Notes required
  • Experience in SharePoint or other database tools a plus

Competencies

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to articulate issues in plain and clear language orally (as well as in writing) which enables the audience to follow easily
  • Strong relationship building skills
  • Ability to handle stress and high volumes
  • Ability to reach solutions proactively, quickly and diplomatically

  • Ability to work independently, with minimal to no oversight

What You Do at AMD Changes Everything

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. MTS Power and Performance Engineer

The Role

AMD s Computing and Graphics business unit is seeking a technical leader to drive next generation power architecture, firmware, algorithms, and software interfaces across AMD client and handheld SoCs. In this highly influential role, you will help define the power management architecture for future AMD platforms driving innovation from early concept and definition, through design execution, and into post silicon validation.
You will collaborate closely with SoC and platform architects, IP and physical design teams, software and firmware engineering, silicon validation, and packaging teams to deliver breakthrough improvements in power efficiency, performance per watt, and battery life. This is an opportunity to have a direct and visible impact on AMD s most advanced products. You are a deep technical thinker with strong problem solving and communication skills. You excel at explaining complex concepts through publications, presentations, or executive briefings.
You thrive in highly collaborative environments, mentor others naturally, and raise the collective expertise of the teams around you. You combine practical hands on skills with system level vision, and you are energized by building algorithms and firmware that shape silicon behavior.

Key Responsibilities

Algorithm, Firmware Software Interface Architecture

  • Develop and architect new power algorithms and software features using state of the art techniques, including classfiers, regression models, machine learning approches for CPU/GPU power and performance optimization.
  • Define and implement software interfaces that influence and optimize hardware behavior across the SoC.
  • Prototype and develop new firmware for complex power control algorithms throughout the SoC roadmap.

Performance Workload Optimization

  • Profile emerging NN and LLM (Agentic) workloads on client platforms; tune algorithms to optimize power during active, high load, and interactive usage scenarios.
  • Analyze power and performance benchmarks to identify opportunities for efficiency improvements.

System Level Power Architecture

  • Drive cross organization alignment for innovative power reduction methodologies and ensure convergence across design teams.
  • Collaborate with global architecture and design teams to implement and validate SoC power management solutions.

Hands On Engineering

  • Conduct software tracing, firmware debugging, and activity profiling to diagnose issues and drive improvements.

  • Experience profiling software workloads on CPUs and GPUs.
  • Knowledge of defining low level software interfaces to influence hardware performance and power behavior.
  • Background in SOC hardware design, clock distribution, power delivery and performance
  • Experience profiling and tuning hardware/software stacks to achieve power and performance efficiency on benchmark workloads.

title: Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer - AI Platform
jobDescription:
Job Summary

We are looking for a Sr. Staff AI Platform Engineer to join our team. This is an On-site role based in Bangalore/Pune, reporting to the Senior Manager in the IT Data Strategy department. In this position, you will design, scale, and maintain enterprise cloud infrastructure and platform capabilities to support production AI/ML workloads. Operating within the IT Data Strategy team, you will drive infrastructure automation, observability, and platform governance while empowering AI and data engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions reliably and securely.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available AWS infrastructure (EKS, Lambda, ECS, VPC, IAM) for AI/ML workloads using Terraform, following IaC best practices including reusable modules, remote state management, and environment-based blueprints
  • Own and continuously evolve GitLab CI/CD pipelines for AI platform services, automating build, test, security scanning, and multi-environment deployment workflows to enable fast, reliable, and repeatable releases
  • Architect a centralized observability stack using Prometheus and Grafana with golden-signal dashboards across AI/ML services and infrastructure, design intelligent alerting strategies (Alertmanager, PagerDuty, OpsGenie), and lead incident response, root-cause analysis, and postmortems to improve MTTA/MTTR
  • Define and track DORA metrics to drive delivery and reliability improvements, while building self-healing, auto-scaling, and cost-optimized infrastructure for AI/ML services (LLM inference, vector databases, agent frameworks) on Kubernetes (EKS)
  • Implement infrastructure security best practices, establish platform governance standards, partner with AI/ML and data engineering teams on production-grade AI/RAG deployments, and mentor junior/mid-level engineers through design and code reviews

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You act like an owner with a passion for the mission, operating with integrity and navigating seamlessly between high-level platform strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator who is ambitious for the overall team, fostering an open feedback culture delivered with clarity and respect to build lasting trust.
  • You are driven by innovation and deep technical curiosity, continuously seeking secure, scalable, and modern solutions to complex platform engineering challenges.
  • You champion simplicity by distilling complex technical architecture, user needs, and operational concepts into clear, actionable plans and focused communication.
  • You are data-driven, leveraging analytics and measurable metrics to guide informed engineering decisions, evaluate truth, and optimize reliability.

What We re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
  • 8+ years of experience as a Platform Engineer / Site Reliability Engineer / DevOps Engineer, including 3+ years supporting AI/ML or data platform infrastructure, with deep hands-on expertise in AWS (EKS, Lambda, ECS, VPC, IAM, S3)
  • Strong hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform (modules, workspaces, remote state) and designing/maintaining CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI/CD (or equivalent), including runners and deployment automation
  • Proven expertise in centralized observability using Prometheus and Grafana (custom exporters, dashboard design, alerting rules), along with experience designing and tuning alerting/on-call systems (Alertmanager, PagerDuty, OpsGenie) and owning incident response for production services
  • Solid, hands-on understanding of DevOps/DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, MTTR) and how to use them to drive engineering improvement
  • Experience deploying and operating containerized applications on Kubernetes (EKS), including Helm charts and autoscaling (HPA, Cluster Autoscaler, Karpenter), combined with strong scripting skills in Python (and/or Go/Bash) and the ability to work independently and lead complex infrastructure initiatives with excellent communication skills befitting a Staff-level engineer

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience with LiteLLM (including multi-geo/multi-region deployment patterns), distributed compute frameworks like Ray.io/Anyscale, workflow engines like Temporal, and agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or LlamaIndex
  • Working knowledge of vector database platforms (Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate), memory/context layers like ZEP, LLMOps/MLOps frameworks and practices (model registry, prompt versioning, feedback loops, MLflow/Kubeflow), and LLM observability/evaluation tooling such as Arize Phoenix
  • Exposure to GitOps workflows (ArgoCD/Flux), log aggregation and distributed tracing (Loki, ELK/OpenSearch, Jaeger/Tempo), cloud cost optimization (FinOps), and security/compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001) in cloud-native environments

jobDescription:
BASIC FUNCTION

The Junior Supply Chain Risk Analyst will assist in identifying, assessing, and managing risks associated with third parties. The junior analyst will support various departments and stakeholders in developing and implementing effective risk management strategies.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Risk Assessment Support: Assist in assessing risks including Geographical, Reputational, Cyber Security, Sanctions, Human Resources, Business Continuity, Anti-Bribery/Anti-Corruption, Artificial Intelligence, ESG, and Privacy.
  • Daily Operations: Support day-to-day responsibilities of the SCRM program, including intake and handling of requests for new third parties, gathering documentation for due diligence and onboarding tasks, and maintaining the SCRM database.
  • Monitoring: Help monitor third parties for changes in their risk profile, including mergers and acquisitions, regulatory changes, and other external factors.
  • Risk Assessment: Conduct preliminary risk assessments on new and existing third parties under supervision.
  • Database Maintenance: Ensure the integrity of the SCRM database by accurately documenting and consistently updating contact information, products, and services to maintain reliable and trustworthy data.
  • Reporting: Assist in generating standardized reports to inform business owners and management on third-party risk and performance.
  • Risk Management: Support effective risk management change initiatives.
  • Support: Provide support and expertise to business owners on third-party relationship management.
  • Incident Management: Assist in the ongoing management of escalations and incidents related to due diligence and monitoring of third parties.
  • Remediation: Help facilitate or assist in the remediation of any third-party-related findings or issues.
  • Program Improvement: Contribute to the improvement of the Supply Chain Risk Management Program.
  • Vendor Communication: Communicate with third-party vendors to address identified risks and ensure compliance with contractual obligations and regulatory requirements.
  • Industry Trends: Stay abreast of industry trends and best practices related to Supply Chain Risk Management.
  • Special Projects: Assist with any special projects as needed.

OTHER DUTIES

  • Additional duties as directed by management.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Bachelor s degree in Information Security, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Relevant internships or up to 1 year of experience in third-party risk management or a related field.

Other Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, or Certifications:

  • Analytical Skills: Basic ability to evaluate data and identify potential risks and vulnerabilities.
  • Communication Skills: Proficient in effectively conveying information to various stakeholders.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Basic familiarity with regulatory requirements related to third-party risk management, such as GDPR, HIPAA, ESG, or PCI-DSS.
  • Technical Proficiency: Skilled in Microsoft Office Suite and willingness to learn risk management software.
  • Organizational Skills: Strong organizational and time management abilities.
  • Attention to Detail: Keen attention to detail, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Teamwork and Independence: Capable of working both independently and collaboratively to deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in Learning Operations, Program Management, Professional Services Operations, or a related operational leadership field in a high-growth technology environment.

jobDescription:
About J-PAL South Asia:
J-PAL is a global research centre working to reduce poverty and fight climate change by ensuring that policy is informed by scientific evidence. Anchored by a network of over 1,100 researchers at universities across the world, J-PAL works with governments, NGOs, and donors to generate evidence and scale effective solutions. J-PAL South Asia, based at the Institute for Financial Management and Research (IFMR) in Chennai, leads J-PAL s efforts to advance evidence-informed policymaking across the region. The office works with over 20 state governments and multiple central ministries in India, across sectors including health, education, labour markets, energy, environment, climate action, and gender.
J-PAL South Asia hosts CLEAR South Asia, the Regional Centre for Learning on Evaluation and Results, coordinated by the World Bank s Independent Evaluation Group (IEG). CLEAR South Asia is a key implementing partner of the Global Evaluation Initiative (GEI), a global network of institutions dedicated to strengthening evaluation capacities in developing countries.
About the Training Vertical:
The Training vertical at J-PAL South Asia works to strengthen monitoring, evaluation, data, and evidence-use capacities and systems. The team delivers open-enrolment and customised courses, technical advisory services, fellowships, knowledge products, and long-term institutional capacity-building engagements with governments and other development partners. J-PAL South Asia also hosts CLEAR South Asia, a key implementing partner of the Global Evaluation Initiative.
Role Summary:
J-PAL South Asia seeks a data-focused Training Manager / Senior Manager to lead the design and delivery of capacity-building programmes that help public institutions and social-sector organisations improve how they collect, manage, analyse, govern, and use data for decision-making and evaluation. The role sits at the intersection of applied data analytics, monitoring and evaluation, adult learning, and institutional strengthening.
The successful candidate will translate real-world administrative and programme data challenges into rigorous, practice-oriented curricula and advisory engagements. They will lead technical content development, facilitate training for diverse audiences, manage partnerships and programmes, mentor team members, and help build a portfolio of data-capacity initiatives that is closely connected to J-PAL s research and policy mission.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Data-focused training strategy and portfolio development
    • Support the development and execution of the Training vertical s strategy for data and evidence capacity building, translating priorities into annual plans, milestones, budgets, and measurable outcomes.
    • Contribute to thought leadership on the evolving role of data systems, AI, and digital tools in M&E practice, helping government partners navigate opportunities and risks as these technologies reshape how evidence is generated and used in public systems.
    • Identify opportunities for new courses, technical assistance, fellowships, and institutional partnerships focused on administrative data, data governance, analytics, and evidence use.
    • Build a coherent pathway from foundational data literacy to advanced applied analytics, tailored to the needs of government officials, M&E practitioners, researchers, and implementing organisations.
    • Contribute to fundraising, proposal development, donor engagement, and the stewardship of existing grants.
  • Curriculum and technical content development
    • Lead the design, adaptation, and quality assurance of curricula, teaching materials, exercises, datasets, manuals, toolkits, and knowledge products on data-focused topics.
    • Develop applied learning content using realistic government and social-sector datasets, while ensuring confidentiality, ethical use, and appropriate data protection.
    • Create training modules for partners on topics such as data quality assessment, data cleaning and validation, reproducible workflows, administrative data systems, data visualisation, dashboarding, data governance, responsible data use, and the use of data for monitoring and evaluation.
    • Translate technical concepts into accessible and engaging learning experiences for audiences with different levels of quantitative proficiency.
    • Keep content current by drawing on J-PAL research, field experience, partner needs, and emerging good practices in public-interest data systems.
  • Training delivery and facilitation
    • Lead and facilitate high-quality in-person, virtual, and blended training programmes for government and non-government stakeholders.
    • Teach technical sessions and oversee hands-on labs using relevant software such as Excel, Stata, R, Python, SQL, or data-visualisation tools.
    • Design assessments, assignments, capstone exercises, and feedback mechanisms that measure learning and application rather than participation alone.
    • Coach other trainers and subject-matter experts to ensure consistency, accuracy, strong pedagogy, and an inclusive learner experience.
  • Technical advisory and institutional data-capacity strengthening
    • Work with state and central government partners, civil society organisations, and other institutions to diagnose data-system and analytical-capacity gaps.
    • Translate partner needs into feasible technical assistance plans, including data-quality protocols, documentation standards, reporting frameworks, analytical workflows, and capacity-building roadmaps.
    • Advise partners on strengthening data collection, metadata, data dictionaries, codebooks, validation rules, reproducible analysis, and responsible data-sharing practices.
    • Support partners to move from one-off analysis towards institutionalised routines for monitoring, learning, and evidence-informed decision-making.
    • Coordinate with J-PAL s research and policy teams to identify data assets and problem statements that may support future research or evaluation opportunities.
  • Programme and partnership management
    • Manage multiple training and advisory engagements end to end, including scoping, work planning, staffing, contracting, delivery, risk management, reporting, and close-out.
    • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior government officials, donors, universities, technical partners, and civil society organisations.
    • Ensure programmes are responsive to partner needs while maintaining J-PAL s standards for technical quality and ethical data use.
    • Represent the Training vertical in external meetings, workshops, and ecosystem convenings.
  • Learning, knowledge management, and evidence of programme effectiveness
    • Develop monitoring, evaluation, and learning frameworks for data-capacity programmes, tracking learning gains, application of skills, institutional adoption, and improvements in data practices.
    • Create and maintain reusable repositories of curricula, code examples, teaching datasets, templates, case studies, and delivery guidance.
    • Lead the production of practical briefs, case notes, playbooks, and donor-facing learning products that document what works in strengthening institutional data capacity.
    • Use learner and partner feedback to continuously improve programme design and delivery.
  • Team leadership and organisational contribution
    • Supervise, mentor, and support Training Associates, Senior Training Associates, consultants as the need may be.
    • Set clear goals and quality standards, review technical outputs, and support the professional development of team members.
    • Contribute to financial and operational management, grant reporting, recruitment, and cross-vertical organisational initiatives.
    • Promote a collaborative culture that combines technical rigour, practical problem-solving, and strong partner orientation.
Minimum Qualifications:
  • Master s degree in economics, statistics, data science, computer science and AI, engineering or a related quantitative or social science field.
  • For Manager: at least 5 years of relevant professional experience. For Senior Manager: typically 7 or more years of relevant experience, including substantial programme or team leadership.
  • Demonstrated experience using data for public policy, monitoring and evaluation, social-impact programmes, government advisory, or applied research.
  • Strong applied data-analysis skills and proficiency in at least one statistical programming language such as R, or Python; working knowledge of SQL is strongly preferred.
  • Experience working with large, messy, or administrative datasets, including data cleaning, validation, documentation, analysis, and visualisation.
  • Strong understanding of monitoring and evaluation concepts, research workflows, and the role of administrative data in evidence-informed decision-making.
  • Experience designing and delivering technical training, workshops, curricula, or advisory services for adult learners.

jobDescription:
Senior AI Presales (Principal Consultant) (Full-Stack & Generative AI)
Location: Mumbai (only)
Type of Hire: Full-Time
Min: 15+ yrs

Job Summary
We are seeking a high-impact, strategic AI Presales Consultant to join our elite team. This is not a standard presales role. You will engage "upstream" with our most strategic clients, acting as their primary technical and strategic advisor on their end-to-end AI journey, from initial AI curiosity to a fully architected and scalable MLOps platform. You will design the "how" of their AI strategy
Your mission is to position our entire full-stack AI portfolio, translating complex business challenges into fully architected solutions. You will be the expert who connects the business use case to the underlying supercomputing hardware, with a strong emphasis on our AI Platform. You will guide clients through the complexities of modern AIfrom data pipelines and RAG architectures to model selection, inference optimization, and precise infrastructure sizing. If you are passionate about building the factory for AI, not just the product, this role is for you.

What We Don't Expect (Focus of the Role)

  • You are not expected to be a hardware specialist (e.g., designing server racks or comparing GPU silicon).
  • You are not expected to be a domain-specific data scientist (e.g., building the final fraud detection model or NLP algorithm).
  • Your focus is the platform that enables these two ends of the spectrum.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Client Advisory: Lead executive-level "Art of the Possible" workshops and technical discovery sessions to understand a client's business goals, data readiness, and AI maturity.
  • Full-Stack Solution Architecture: Design holistic, end-to-end AI solutions that synergize our supercomputing hardware, AI software platform, and MLOps capabilities to meet specific client needs.
  • Generative AI & LLM Expertise: Act as the subject matter expert on Generative AI. Architect and evangelize scalable data ingestion and preparation pipelines, specializing in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) frameworks.
  • Infrastructure Sizing & Performance Modelling: Analyse customer workloads (data volume, model complexity, training frequency, inference throughput) to accurately size the required platform infrastructure, including Kubernetes clusters, data storage, and software licenses. This includes calculating compute, storage, and network requirements based on key performance metrics like model parameters, token performance (tokens/sec), desired latency, and concurrent user load.
  • Model & Software Consultation:
  • Advise clients on AI model selection, comparing the trade-offs of open-source vs. proprietary LLMs, fine-tuning vs. foundation models, and model quantization.
  • Position and demonstrate our proprietary AI software platform, MLOps tools, and libraries, integrating them into the client's ecosystem.
  • Inference Optimization: Design and architect robust, low-latency, and high-throughput inference solutions for complex AI models, including large-scale LLM serving.
  • User Experience (UX) Advocacy: Collaborate with client teams to define the end-user experience, ensuring the solution delivers tangible business value and a seamless interface for data scientists, analysts, and application users.
  • Sales Cycle Enablement: Own the technical narrative throughout the sales cycle. Build and deliver compelling presentations, custom demonstrations, and Proofs of Concept (PoCs). Lead the technical response to complex RFIs/RFPs.

Required Skills & Qualifications

AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.




We are seeking an experienced AI Platform Engineer to design, deploy, and optimize AI/ML infrastructure, AI workflows, and automated pipelines. This role focuses on building scalable environments for training and deploying machine learning models, leveraging modern orchestration, automation, and GPU acceleration technologies. You will collaborate with data scientists and platform engineers to drive efficient resource utilization and scalable operations across cloud and hybrid environments.
Key Responsibilities
    • Kubernetes for AI/ML: Architect and manage Kubernetes clusters tailored to AI/ML workloads.

    • Automation Pipelines: Develop and maintain Python-based automation scripts and ML pipelines; automate infrastructure provisioning with Terraform and configuration management with Ansible.
    • Notebooks Collaboration: Create and manage Jupyter Notebooks for experimentation and collaboration.
    • NVIDIA Integration: Integrate and optimize NVIDIA Enterprise Suite components (CUDA, NeMo Framework, Triton, TensorRT, GPU drivers) for accelerated computing.
    • MLOps Practices: Establish and maintain MLOps best practices for model lifecycle management, CI/CD, and monitoring (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow).
    • Collaboration: Work closely with data scientists and platform engineers to ensure efficient resource utilization and scalability across environments.
Required Skills Experience
    • Strong proficiency in Python and experience with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch).
    • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.
    • Familiarity with Run:ai or similar GPU scheduling platforms.
    • Expertise in Terraform and Ansible for infrastructure automation.
    • Experience with Jupyter Notebooks for ML development.
    • Knowledge of NVIDIA Enterprise Suite (CUDA, NeMo Framework, Triton, GPU drivers).
    • Solid understanding of MLOps principles and tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow).
    • Background in deploying and scaling AI workloads in cloud or hybrid environments.
Qualifications
    • 4+ years in platform architecture or solutions architecture, with 2+ years focused on AI/ML workloads.
    • Experience with high-performance computing (HPC) environments.
    • Familiarity with distributed training and model optimization techniques.
    • Certification in Kubernetes or cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.

We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

title: Senior Generative AI Developer-Full Time
jobDescription:
Job Requirement

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Generative AI Developer to join our AI/ML team. This role focuses on leveraging cutting-edge Generative AI (GenAI) technologies to drive innovation and efficiency in software development and business processes. The ideal candidate will work on advanced techniques such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), document chunking, and data embedding across multiple vector databases. They will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and optimize AI-driven solutions, with exposure to cloud-native AI platforms like Amazon Bedrock and Microsoft Azure OpenAI considered a plus.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and deploy GenAI-based applications to solve complex business problems.
  • Implement RAG frameworks to enhance information retrieval and response accuracy.
  • Design and optimize document chunking strategies tailored to specific data types and use cases.
  • Build and manage data embeddings using various vector databases for high-performance similarity searches.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and scientists to integrate AI solutions seamlessly into existing pipelines.
  • Explore and implement best practices for leveraging Amazon Bedrock and Azure OpenAI services.
  • Stay updated on emerging trends and technologies in the GenAI and AI/ML landscape.

Required Technical Skillsets

Mandatory Skills:

  • Proficiency in Generative AI frameworks and technologies like
    • Prompt Engineering creating specific prompts to guide LLM outputs
    • Fine Tuning and Few-Shot learning Adapting LLMs for domain-specific tasks.
    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Combining LLMs with external data retrieval systems
    • Text-to-Text Transfer Transformation (T5) Framework for translating tasks into text forms.
  • Expertise in designing and implementing chunking strategies for diverse datasets.
  • Strong knowledge of data embedding techniques and working experience with vector databases like Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus.
  • Solid programming skills in Python, with experience in AI/ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and services for AI/ML workloads (AWS or Azure).
  • Experience with API integration for AI services and building scalable applications.

Desirable Skills:

  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock and/or Microsoft Azure OpenAI services.
  • Knowledge of natural language processing (NLP) techniques and large language model (LLM) fine-tuning.
  • Exposure to different chunking strategies, including overlap and semantic segmentation.
  • Understanding of DevOps practices for deploying and managing AI models in production.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a focus on delivering value-driven solutions.

Years of Experience:

  • Overall experience 5 to 12 years
  • Hands-on experience in Python 5+ years
  • AI/ML experience 4+ years

Note: Looking for Immediate to 15-Days joiners at most.

  • Experience training and serving CV models (ResNet/EfficientNet, YOLO/RetinaNet, U-Net/nnU-Net, Vision Transformers), and familiarity with ASR/TTS pipelines (e.g., Whisper, torchaudio).
  • Practical knowledge of model optimization (ONNX/TensorRT, quantization), and data tooling (Pandas, NumPy, OpenCV, ffmpeg).
  • Proficiency with MLOps tooling: experiment tracking (MLflow/W&B), model registry, CI/CD, monitoring/logging (Prometheus/Grafana/Cloud Monitoring).

    • Implement, fine-tune, and evaluate CV models (classification, detection, segmentation, tracking) using PyTorch/TensorFlow.

title: Executive Assistant To CEO (UK- Property Management)
jobDescription:
Executive Assistant to Managing Director - Operations & Project

Coordination


Location: Remote India

Type: Full-time
Salary: 50000 to 65000 per month ( for outstanding candidates can be higher than this )
Progression: Significant opportunity to develop into broader operational responsibilities as the group continues to grow


About the Company : We are a UK-based group of companies operating across:


  • Residential architecture
  • Structural engineering
  • Residential property management

Over the last few years, the group has grown to a team of more than 25 people, with most of our operational team working remotely from India.We place a strong emphasis on:


  • Clear systems and processes
  • Accountability
  • Operational efficiency
  • Automation
  • AI
  • Modern technology
  • Taking responsibility for outcomes rather than simply completing individual actions
  • Our team uses platforms including ChatGPT, Claude, Trello, TeamGantt, Fireflies, Microsoft 365 and other integrated business systems.

As the group continues to grow, we are looking for an exceptionally capable Executive Assistant to work directly with the Managing Director and take responsibility for a wide range of administrative, operational and coordination tasks.


The Role


This is not simply a diary-management Executive Assistant position. We are looking for someone who can become the Managing Director's highly capable right hand. The role combines:


  • Executive assistance
  • Business administration
  • Task ownership
  • Basic project coordination
  • Follow-up and accountability
  • AI-assisted work
  • Basic property portfolio management
  • General operational support

A major part of your job will be taking tasks away from the Managing Director and making sure they actually get completed.


You may need to coordinate several other employees in order to achieve this.For example, you may be given an objective that requires input from accounts, IT and another department.


Your responsibility is not simply to send everyone an email.Your responsibility is to coordinate the actions, follow up where necessary, identify problems and ensure the required outcome is achieved.


We are looking for someone who understands the difference between:

I sent the reminder. and The task was completed.That distinction is extremely important to us.


1. Executive Support: You will help manage the Managing Director's day-to-day business workload. This may include:


  • Managing and organizing the calendar
  • Arranging meetings
  • Preparing information before meetings
  • Following up actions after meetings
  • Drafting emails and correspondence
  • Organising documents and information
  • Researching issues
  • Keeping track of commitments
  • Managing reminders and deadlines
  • Making appointments
  • Obtaining information from other employees
  • Dealing with routine matters without unnecessary escalation
  • Filtering administrative issues before they reach the Managing Director

The objective is to reduce the number of routine matters requiring Managing Director involvement.Where something can reasonably be handled by you, we expect you to take ownership of it.


2. Task Ownership and Follow-ThroughThis is one of the most important parts of the position.The Managing Director will regularly give you tasks or outcomes to achieve.Sometimes these will have clearly defined steps.Other times you may simply be told:Can you sort this out?You should be capable of:


  • Understanding what the required outcome is
  • Working out what needs to happen
  • Identifying who needs to be involved
  • Allocating or requesting actions from colleagues
  • Setting or confirming deadlines
  • Following up outstanding work
  • Checking that information has been received
  • Resolving straightforward problems
  • Identifying when something is going off track
  • Escalating genuinely important issues
  • Confirming that the final outcome has actually been achieved

We do not want someone who considers their responsibility complete simply because they have sent an email or reminder.We want someone who takes responsibility for getting the task over the finish line.


3. Project and Team CoordinationThe role includes basic project coordination.You do not need to be a professionally trained Project Manager and we are not looking for someone focused on complex project-management methodology.However, you should be comfortable coordinating tasks between several people.For example, the Managing Director may decide that the company needs to introduce a new process.You may then need to:


  • Identify the actions required
  • Work out which employees need to be involved
  • Create a simple action plan
  • Coordinate different team members
  • Keep track of deadlines
  • Follow up outstanding tasks
  • Identify delays
  • Make sure dependencies are dealt with
  • Keep the Managing Director informed where necessary
  • Confirm that the new process has actually been implemented

You should be capable of taking something from: Objective Actions Owners Follow-Up Completion Previous experience with project coordination would therefore be useful.


4. AI and Technology Strong practical AI skills are a core requirement for this role. We believe that a modern Executive Assistant should be capable of using AI to dramatically improve their productivity. You should already use, or be highly comfortable using, tools such as ChatGPT and Claude in your normal working life. You may use AI to help with:


  • Research
  • Drafting emails
  • Summarizing meetings
  • Analyzing transcripts
  • Organizing information
  • Comparing documents
  • Preparing reports
  • Creating checklists
  • Drafting procedures
  • Structuring unclear information
  • Researching unfamiliar subjects
  • Preparing meeting notes
  • Solving administrative problems
  • Improving existing processes

You do not need to be a programmer or AI engineer. However, candidates who have little practical experience with AI and little interest in becoming highly proficient with it are unlikely to be suitable. Equally, we do not want someone who blindly copies and pastes AI-generated answers. You must be capable of:


  • Giving AI clear instructions
  • Providing appropriate context
  • Reviewing outputs critically
  • Spotting mistakes
  • Improving the result
  • Using your own judgement

AI should make you more capable it should not replace your judgement.


5. Basic Property Portfolio Management: One of the companies within the group, CEB Properties, operates a very small UK residential property portfolio of approximately six properties.Part of your role will involve handling its routine day-to-day administration.


This is not a specialist property-management position, and the portfolio is deliberately small.


The company is building clear operating systems, workflows, checklists and procedures to make these tasks straightforward to manage.

Typical responsibilities may include:


  • Responding to routine tenant communication
  • Coordinating property viewings
  • Arranging maintenance
  • Contacting contractors
  • Following up repairs
  • Coordinating check-ins and check-outs
  • Organising referencing
  • Managing routine tenancy administration
  • Keeping property records organised
  • Monitoring safety and compliance deadlines
  • Arranging periodic inspections
  • Making sure routine property tasks are completed

Previous property-management or real-estate experience would be an advantage because you will already understand some of these processes. However, it is not essential


A capable and organized person should be able to learn this part of the role quickly using the systems provided.


6. Business Administration : You will take responsibility for a variety of routine business-administration tasks across the group.This may include:

  • Insurance renewals
  • Insurance claims administration
  • Obtaining quotations
  • Managing subscriptions
  • Supplier accounts
  • Routine business registrations
  • Organising company records
  • Renewing services
  • Basic purchasing
  • Booking appointments
  • Researching suppliers or services
  • Filling in forms
  • Following up third parties
  • Organising documents
  • Maintaining records
  • Updating trackers
  • Managing routine correspondence
  • Checking that recurring administrative tasks have been completed

We need someone who does not consider ordinary administrative work beneath them. At the same time, we want you to continually look for ways to make repetitive work easier.


You should naturally ask:


Can this be simplified?

Can AI help with this?

Can this be automated?

Can we create a template?

Can we create a checklist so we don't have to rethink this next time?


7. Follow-Up and Accountability Across the Team: Because we have a team of more than 20 people, the Managing Director cannot personally follow up every outstanding action. You will help create accountability. his may involve:


  • Following up department heads
  • Following up individual team members
  • Requesting updates
  • Checking deadlines
  • Identifying overdue actions
  • Confirming whether tasks have actually been completed
  • Organising information from several people
  • Highlighting problems
  • Escalating matters when genuinely necessary

You must therefore be comfortable politely but persistently following up colleagues, including people who may be more senior than you within their own department.


We are looking for somebody who is pleasant and professional but persistent.


8. Process Improvement: You do not need to be an operations Manager. However, we want someone who naturally likes organized ways of working. As you become familiar with the business, you may help:


  • Improve checklists
  • Create templates
  • Document recurring tasks
  • Improve simple procedures
  • Organise filing systems
  • Identify unnecessary administration
  • Improve trackers
  • Identify repetitive work that could be automated
  • Use AI to improve routine processes

The Managing Director and Operations team will develop many of the larger operating systems.


Your job will often be to work effectively within those systems and help improve them through practical experience.

The Person We Are Looking For


We are looking for someone who is:


  • Extremely organised
  • Highly proactive
  • Intelligent and quick to learn
  • Dependable
  • Persistent
  • Detail-oriented
  • Comfortable working independently
  • Comfortable coordinating other employees
  • Capable of managing several tasks simultaneously
  • Strong at following work through to completion
  • Confident communicating with department heads
  • Excellent in written and spoken English
  • Technically confident
  • Comfortable learning new software
  • Already comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude
  • Capable of researching unfamiliar subjects
  • Able to use common sense and judgement
  • Solutions-focused
  • Discreet and trustworthy
  • Comfortable carrying out basic administrative work

Most importantly, you should have a strong sense of ownership.

If you are given responsibility for something, we want you to think:I am responsible for making sure this gets done.Particularly

Relevant Experience


We would be particularly interested in candidates who have previously worked as:


  • Executive Assistant
  • Executive Assistant to Founder / CEO / Managing Director
  • Senior Executive Assistant
  • Founders Office Associate
  • Business Operations Associate
  • Operations Executive
  • Business Support Executive
  • Executive Operations Associate
  • Administrative Manager

Experience involving any of the following would also be particularly valuable:


  • Project coordination
  • Property management
  • Real estate
  • Business operations
  • Working with multiple departments
  • Process improvement
  • Startup or SME environments
  • Working directly with a founder or Managing Director
  • AI and automation

You do not need experience in every area. We are more interested in intelligence, ownership, organization, judgement and ability to learn quickly than in finding somebody whose previous job description exactly matches ours.


This Role Is Probably Not Right for You If

This position is unlikely to suit you if:


  • You require detailed instructions for every task
  • You are uncomfortable making straightforward decisions
  • You dislike chasing people for outstanding actions
  • You consider a task complete simply because you sent a reminder
  • You dislike basic administrative work
  • You prefer very narrowly defined responsibilities
  • You struggle to manage several different types of work
  • You are uncomfortable learning new technology
  • You rarely use AI and have little interest in becoming proficient with it
  • You regularly escalate straightforward problems rather than trying to solve them

What Success Looks Like


Within your first six months, we would expect you to have:


  • Taken control of a substantial amount of the Managing Director's routine administration
  • Reduced unnecessary interruptions to the Managing Director
  • Created a reliable system for managing follow-ups and outstanding actions
  • Successfully coordinated multiple tasks involving different employees
  • Taken responsibility for routine administration within the small property portfolio
  • Become confident managing its approximately six properties
  • Taken responsibility for routine business administration such as insurance, suppliers and renewals
  • Become highly proficient with the company's AI tools
  • Improved the organisation of important information and records
  • Assisted with several internal projects
  • Improved or documented recurring administrative processes
  • Demonstrated that when you are given an outcome to achieve, you can take responsibility for getting it completed

Development and Progression: This role has significant scope to develop.


As you become more capable and understand the business, you may progressively take responsibility for:


  • More complex internal projects
  • Wider operational coordination
  • Property operations
  • Business processes
  • Automation initiatives
  • Junior administrative support
  • Cross-departmental initiatives

We are a growing business and are looking for someone who wants to become a highly trusted and capable member of the management support team.


Application


Shortlisted candidates will be assessed primarily on practical capability rather than CV length or impressive job titles.

We are particularly interested in evidence of:


  • Strong practical AI use
  • Exceptional organisation
  • Task ownership
  • Follow-through
  • Problem solving
  • Basic project coordination
  • Clear written communication
  • Good business judgement
  • The ability to take an objective and get it completed

Lead Applied AI / LLM Engineer

PERMANENT FULL-TIME OPPORTUNITY


RAG, Agents & Evaluation | Remote-first within India | Reports to the CTO

The mandate:



AKS is building a permanent technical core of engineers who own outcomes, not isolated tickets. You will take end-to-end responsibility for applied AI systems across discovery, architecture, implementation, evaluation, deployment, UAT, production support, documentation and handover. You will coordinate directly with the CTO, collaborate with the full-stack lead and, where appropriate, guide interns or junior engineers while retaining accountability for the final result.


This is primarily an applied LLM and application-engineering role. Model training and research are part of the toolkit, but the central objective is to deliver reliable systems that work with real client data, constraints and acceptance criteria. A typical portfolio may include one or two active PoC/UAT builds and several systems in hypercare or maintenance.



What makes this role different:


AI coding agents and approved model/tool subscriptions are provided and encouraged. You remain accountable for architecture, correctness, security, tests and every accepted change. You must understand and be able to defend the system without relying on the tool that generated a suggestion.


What you will own

  • Convert ambiguous business and client problems into written technical outcomes, acceptance criteria and delivery plans.
  • Design, build and maintain production-oriented RAG, agentic and document-intelligence systems with explicit boundaries between deterministic logic, conventional ML and generative components.
  • Own ingestion, retrieval, embeddings, vector search, prompting, structured outputs, tool use, orchestration, guardrails and human-review paths.
  • Build defensible evaluations for retrieval quality, groundedness, citations, entity isolation, refusal behaviour, latency, cost and failure cases; turn production failures into regression tests.
  • Fine-tune models using LoRA or related parameter-efficient methods and deploy reproducible inference-serving workflows.
  • Develop production-quality Python services and APIs; integrate AI components with FastAPI applications, PostgreSQL/vector stores and frontend or workflow systems.
  • Deploy and troubleshoot services on cloud and client-controlled Linux/GPU environments using Docker, CI/CD, logging and monitoring.
  • Reuse proven components across applications without creating hidden coupling; improve existing repositories rather than rebuilding everything by default.
  • Maintain clear Git history, pull requests, tests, runbooks, architecture decisions, model/evaluation records and knowledge-transfer material.
  • Communicate progress, dependencies, risks and production incidents clearly to the CTO, delivery stakeholders and clients where required.
  • Review work and nurture interns or junior engineers when assigned; ownership cannot be delegated away.


Required capabilities

  • 3–7 years of relevant software, ML or applied-AI experience, including personally shipped systems.
  • Strong Python engineering and hands-on PyTorch proficiency.
  • Strong foundations in statistics, statistical machine learning, deep learning, experimental design and practical model evaluation.
  • Production experience with LLM applications, RAG or agentic workflows; ability to diagnose retrieval, grounding, hallucination, identity and tool-use failures.
  • Hands-on LoRA fine-tuning and inference serving, including data preparation, baselines, leakage control, versioning, evaluation, capacity and rollback considerations.
  • Working knowledge of embeddings, vector databases, information retrieval, structured extraction and document-processing pipelines.
  • Strong Git and GitHub proficiency: branches, pull requests, reviewable commits, code review and repository hygiene.
  • Strong Linux, Docker, REST API, testing and debugging skills; working knowledge of CI/CD, monitoring and at least one cloud platform.
  • Ability to reason about security, privacy, client-data boundaries, model/provider selection, cost, latency and production fallback behaviour.
  • Clear written and verbal communication; direct client discovery or review experience is highly valued.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or another relevant quantitative discipline.


Preferred experience

  • Quantization, GPU-memory/performance optimization, vLLM or comparable model-serving frameworks.
  • PostgreSQL with pgvector or other vector stores; Pydantic/FastAPI; evaluation and observability tooling such as MLflow, Langfuse, Phoenix or OpenTelemetry.
  • Enterprise document intelligence, legal/research assistants, RFQ/quotation automation, voice/calling automation or other high-trust workflows.
  • Local/on-premise model deployment, distributed inference, Kubernetes or infrastructure-as-code.
  • Conventional ML problems such as classification, forecasting or ranking where labels, calibration and business-valid metrics matter.
  • Informal technical leadership, code review and guidance of interns/junior engineers.


Success in the first 90 days

  • Establish a verified architecture, data-flow, evaluation and deployment map for the assigned portfolio.
  • Reproduce existing baselines and known failures; resolve at least one bounded maintenance issue through a reviewed deployment.
  • Put representative evaluation/regression checks into the delivery workflow and ship one measurable reliability improvement.
  • Demonstrate a reproducible LoRA training and serving workflow in staging.
  • Lead one active PoC/UAT workstream while maintaining transparent status and risk control across 4–5 systems.
  • Deliver or materially advance one system to a written acceptance milestone and leave reusable, documented components behind.

Work model and support expectations

  • Permanent, full-time and remote-first within India. Attendance at the Gurugram office or client meetings may be required with reasonable notice.
  • Eight working hours on each scheduled workday, excluding breaks. The normal reference window is 9:30 AM–6:30 PM IST with a one-hour meal break; start/end times may flex while preserving mandatory availability from 11:00 AM–4:00 PM IST.
  • Regular Monday–Friday schedule plus two pre-notified working Saturdays per calendar month. The Saturday schedule is communicated before the month begins.
  • Routine overnight support is not expected. Exceptional production incidents may occasionally require availability outside normal hours, handled under company policy and applicable requirements.
  • Client travel is currently infrequent and primarily within NCR. Approved business travel outside NCR is reimbursed; other required travel arrangements are confirmed in advance.

Compensation and support

  • Annual fixed gross salary: INR 24,00,000–28,00,000.

Selection process

About the Role

Wisewit Solutions is looking for a Fisheries Research Analyst AI & Computer Vision to bridge the gap between fisheries domain expertise and AI technology.

The role will involve researching fisheries and aquaculture processes, understanding real-world field challenges, collecting and validating domain data, and working closely with AI/ML and Computer Vision teams to develop practical technology solutions.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of fish/aquaculture species, farming, seafood processing plants, production lines, exports, and fisheries terminology, along with an interest in AI, data and emerging technologies.


Key Responsibilities

Fisheries Domain Research

  • Research Indian marine, inland fisheries and aquaculture practices.
  • Study fish and shrimp species, production processes, farming practices and harvesting operations.
  • Understand fish health, disease indicators, feed, water quality and environmental parameters.
  • Research fisheries value chains, landing centres, farms, processing units and field operations.
  • Identify operational challenges that can potentially be addressed using AI and automation.

AI & Computer Vision Research

  • You will work with AI/ML and Computer Vision teams to translate fisheries requirements into technical inputs.
  • Identify suitable use cases for image-based identification, classification, detection and monitoring.
  • Help define fish/species categories, attributes, visual characteristics and domain-specific classifications.
  • Assist in developing guidelines for image and video data collection.
  • Review and validate AI-generated outputs from a fisheries-domain perspective.
  • Identify false positives, false negatives and domain-specific errors in AI models.
  • Support creation and validation of datasets for Computer Vision and Machine Learning projects.

Data & Dataset Development

  • Collect fisheries-related data from research papers, government sources, field studies and industry sources.
  • Organise and clean structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Support image/video dataset creation and annotation activities.
  • Develop domain-specific taxonomies, labels, metadata and reference datasets.
  • Verify the accuracy and consistency of annotated data.
  • Maintain documentation and version-controlled research references.

Field Research & Validation

  • Conduct field visits to farms, hatcheries, fishing locations, landing centres and processing facilities.
  • Interact with fishermen, farmers, aquaculture professionals and other domain experts.
  • Document actual field processes and operational challenges.
  • Collect images, videos, observations and other relevant field data.
  • Validate whether AI solutions work effectively under real-world conditions.

Research & Documentation

  • Conduct literature reviews and analyse scientific publications.
  • Track developments in fisheries technology, AI applications and aquaculture.
  • Prepare research reports, use-case documents and domain briefs.
  • Create clear documentation for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Present research findings to AI, engineering and business teams.

AI Use Cases You May Work On

Depending on the project, the role may contribute to areas such as:

  • Fish and shrimp species identification
  • Fish size/length estimation
  • Fish counting and biomass estimation
  • Fish quality assessment
  • Disease or abnormality detection
  • Aquaculture pond monitoring
  • Fish grading and sorting
  • Fish catch classification
  • Image/video-based fisheries monitoring
  • Farm productivity analysis
  • Fisheries supply-chain intelligence
  • Computer Vision-based inspection systems

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Fisheries Science, Aquaculture, Marine Biology, Zoology, Aquatic Sciences or a related field.
  • 15 years of experience in fisheries, aquaculture, fisheries research, field research or a related domain.
  • Strong understanding of Indian fisheries/aquaculture practices.
  • Good research, analytical and documentation skills.

Good to Have

  • Experience with image/video data collection or annotation.
  • Knowledge of Python, SQL, Power BI or similar analytical tools.
  • Familiarity with GIS/geospatial data.
  • Experience working with fisheries datasets.
  • Knowledge of fish/shrimp species identification.
  • Experience conducting field surveys or stakeholder interviews.
  • Understanding of AI model evaluation or dataset validation.

Who Would Be a Good Fit?

We are looking for someone who can say:

I understand fisheries, I understand the problem in the field, and I can explain that problem clearly enough for an AI/engineering team to build a solution.”

You don’t need to be an AI engineer. However, you should be curious about AI and comfortable working closely with technical teams.
